content.outro: The lane is walked to its well, past every trade on it.
content.premise: Craft Lane runs off the market road: a smith, a weaver, a baker and a cartographer keep shop along it, and the lane ends at the old well.
content.theme: A lane of four trades, each a two-room building: a front shop that says the trade and a workroom where it is worked — a smithy, a weaver's, a bakery and a cartographer's.
content.title: The Four Trades
